name: UNIQLO
verdict: Being rated: a maintainer decides whether a US customs ruling counts as a finding.
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): on hold for a maintainer. In 2021 US customs held Uniqlo shirts under its order against XPCC cotton and ruled Uniqlo had not shown they were made without forced labour; the rulings were later taken off CBP's site. A failure to disprove, not a finding.
